name: blujay-mcp
description: Official MCP server for Blujay: let Claude, Cursor and other AI assistants text over iMessage, RCS and SMS from your Blujay numbers.
author: Blujay <support@blujay.io>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (require('./package.json').dependencies.blujay.startsWith('file:')) { console.error('Switch blujay to the published npm version before publishing'); process.exit(1) }" && npm run build
